biological_replicate: three biological replicates for each strain

The raw data were obtained from three biological replicates for each strain, were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.0.305 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), and searched against the ToxoDB-46_TgondiiME49 database.
experimental_design: Proteins that were detected in only one of the biological replicate groups or which were present in statistically significantly higher amounts in one of the biological replicate groups with both quantification methods were considered enriched in either control (FLAG-BirA*) or MOB1 (FLAG-BirA*-MOB1) pull-downs.
number_of_biological_replicates: The raw data were obtained from three biological replicates for each strain, were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.0.305 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), and searched against the ToxoDB-46_TgondiiME49 database.
technology_type: Protein identification and quantitation were performed by nanoLC-MS/MS.
